Terms and Conditions

1. Click “Join Now” on the campaign page to register. Only actions completed after successful registration will be counted toward campaign results. 

2. New Users are users who register a BTSE account during the campaign period. Users who registered before the campaign starts are Existing Users. 

3. Task 1: Account assets refer to the total value of assets in your BTSE account, converted to USDT. A snapshot of account assets will be taken before rewards are credited. Registered users who do not meet the account asset requirement will forfeit their Task 1 reward, and the slot will pass to the next eligible user. 

4. Task 2: Limited to the top 1,000 users with a Net Deposit of ≥ 100 USDT, ranked by Net Deposit from highest to lowest. Users with the same Net Deposit are ranked by the time they reached it. 

5. Net Deposit = Total Deposits − Total Withdrawals during the campaign period. Only on-chain USDT deposits qualify. Internal transfers and deposits in other currencies will not be counted. 

6. Task 2: New Users have higher odds of winning the top prize than Existing Users. After the campaign ends, the system will automatically conduct the draw for eligible users based on their Net Deposit. 

7. Task 3: Cumulative trading volume is the sum of Spot and Futures trading volume during the campaign period. Spot Trading Volume = Total Buy Orders + Total Sell Orders (actual executed amounts). Futures Trading Volume = Total Buy Orders + Total Sell Orders (including leverage). Volume generated with Trial Funds or similar vouchers will not be counted. 

8. Task 3: Only the highest tier reached will be credited. vipUSDT and USDT rewards within the same tier can both be received. Rewards are credited in the order targets are reached. If a tier’s slots are full, the reward will be credited at the next lower tier. 

9. Participation does not guarantee a reward. Rewards worth less than 1 USDT will not be credited. 

10. Please redeem and use rewards within the validity period. Expired rewards will be automatically forfeited. See the Rewards Hub for details. 

11. Rewards will be distributed within 14 business days after the campaign ends. The actual token received will be subject to the final distribution. 

12. Rewards cannot be combined with other concurrent BTSE campaigns of the same type (including registration, deposit, or trading campaigns). Only the highest eligible reward will be distributed. 

13. BTSE may disqualify participants and restrict accounts for abnormal activity, including bulk registration, wash trading, or multi-account participation. 

14. Campaign trades must be made via your BTSE main account. Main and sub-accounts are treated as one account, with data combined. 

15. Market maker accounts and BTSE employees are not eligible. 

16. Digital asset trading involves risk. Please participate with caution. BTSE is not liable for any losses arising from participation. 

17. BTSE may suspend or end this campaign early due to technical issues, abnormal market conditions, force majeure, or legal requirements, with notice on the platform. 

18. The campaign is unavailable in restricted jurisdictions, as defined in BTSE’s Terms of Use and platform announcements. 

19. BTSE may modify campaign rules as needed, as announced on the campaign or platform pages. BTSE reserves the right of final interpretation.

FAQ

1. How do I participate in this stock transfer promotion?

No registration is required. Once an eligible user completes their first stock transfer during the promotion, the system automatically calculates the reward based on the amount actually received. Each user can only earn a reward for their first stock transfer.
Transfer stocks in just three steps:
  1. Submit a stock transfer request on Bitget and provide the delivering broker's name and the name and quantity of the stocks to be transferred;
  2. Using the transfer details provided by Bitget, submit a stock transfer-out request to the delivering broker;
  3. Once the stocks have been credited, the system will automatically complete the remaining steps.
Users can check their stock transfer status in real time using the "Track Progress" button on the page.
U.S. stock transfers from Bitget Stock+ to rToken are free of charge but are not eligible for rewards under this promotion.

2. Which stocks can be transferred to Bitget?

The stocks and ETFs currently eligible for transfer are listed on the Bitget stock transfer page.
If a stock is not currently eligible for transfer, users will not be able to select it on the transfer page.

3. Can amounts from multiple stock transfers be combined to calculate rewards?

No.
Rewards for this promotion are calculated only from the amount received in your first stock transfer. Any transfers after that are not eligible for rewards.

4. When will the rewards be distributed?

The rToken reward will be distributed in 3 installments, with 1/3 of the total reward distributed in each installment:
  1. Round 1: The 2nd day after the first stock transfer is credited.
  2. Round 2: The 1st month after the first stock transfer is credited.
  3. Round 3: The 2nd month after the first stock transfer is credited.
The fee rebate voucher will be distributed in a single installment within 3 days after the first stock transfer is successfully credited. The rToken reward will be converted into an rToken quantity based on the price at 10:00 (UTC+8) on the distribution date.

5. Can sub-accounts receive rewards by transferring stocks?

Only users' main accounts are eligible for this promotion. Sub-accounts support all stock transfer features but cannot participate in this promotion.
If a sub-account initiates and completes a stock transfer before the main account, the main account's eligibility will not be affected. If the main account has not previously completed a stock transfer, it can still receive a stock transfer reward through this promotion.

6. Why might some rewards not be distributed?

Before each reward installment is distributed, the system verifies the current value of your rToken holdings.
If your rToken holdings are worth less than 80% of the value credited from your first transfer at that time, the reward for that round will not be distributed.
Eligibility is verified separately for each reward round.

7. How long does a stock transfer usually take? What if it fails?

The time required depends on the delivering broker's processing efficiency, the settlement status of the stocks, and whether the transfer information is complete.
Users can check the current stock transfer status under "Track progress". If the transfer fails, they can resubmit it based on the reason shown on the page or contact Bitget customer service for assistance.

8. How do I check my stock transfer progress and reward status?

Users can select "Track progress" on the promotion page to view the current stock transfer status, including transfer initiated, awaiting transfer-out by the delivering broker, stocks credited, and subsequent processing.
Reward details can be viewed in the "Reward Center," including the actual stock transfer amount, applicable reward tier, reward amount, and distribution status of each round.

https://square.htx.com/htx-releases-octo.html:
Since the start of Q4, the crypto market has continued to weaken amid volatility. Major asset prices have pulled back from their highs, and market participants have become more cautious. As the market cools, HTX has focused its efforts on solidifying its trading fundamentals and offering diverse yield generation pathways. In October, HTX saw a significant overall improvement in the market depth of its core spot trading pairs, with the 0.05% depth for the BTC/USDT pair increasing by 78%. Meanwhile, the platform’s total count  of stock trading assets grew to 307, with cumulative TradFi trading volume surpassing 7.5 billion USDT. At the end of October, HTX Earn launched the APY Boost Promotion as part of the HTX Winter Campaign, delivering stable yield options for users amid fluctuating market conditions.

Overall Spot Depth Enhancement, Ensuring Smoother Execution for Large-Volume Trades

In October, HTX continued to strengthen its collaboration with professional market makers, improving market-making support, order book depth, and the overall trading environment, which contributed to an overall improvement in the market depth of its core spot trading pairs. Taking BTC/USDT as an example, the pair’s 0.01% depth increased by 42% in October, while its 0.05% depth jumped by 78%. Deeper market depth ensures that orders of the same size have a smaller price impact, allowing large-volume trades to be executed closer to market price. For core assets like BTC, this means users can easily execute trades even during periods of severe market volatility.

Centered around the two core assets of BTC and ETH, HTX also rolled out a series of trading rewards in October, including trading challenges, fee rebates, trading lucky draws, and iPhone Duo theme activities, with the flagship trading challenge attracting over 10,000 participants.

Asset Matrix Continues to Expand, Stock Trading Assets Reach 307 Types

In October, HTX Futures launched 40 new assets, including 29 selected stocks and ETFs alongside 11 crypto assets. To date, the platform’s number of stock trading assets has grown to 307, covering core US stocks, major global indices and ETFs, biopharmaceuticals, energy infrastructure, and Asia-Pacific market leaders. Overall platform liquidity and user activity have both reached new highs.

This month’s new listings focused on sectors including AI computing power and hardware innovation, biopharmaceuticals and healthcare, mass consumption and high-dividend blue chips, as well as Asia-Pacific core markets and frontier technologies. Targets such as STMicroelectronics (STM), United Microelectronics (UMC), Synopsys (SNPS), Constellation Energy (CEG), Pfizer (PFE), Boeing (BA), Procter & Gamble (PG), McDonald’s (MCD), Starbucks (SBUX), Indonesia Index ETF (EIDO), and Taiyo Yuden (TAIYOYUDEN) were rolled out in succession, offering a balanced mix of growth-oriented tech stocks and defensive assets like consumer goods and pharmaceuticals.

As HTX continues to expand its asset offerings, cumulative TradFi trading volume has surpassed $7.5 billion, with $1.5 billion added in October alone.

In the spot asset category, new listings introduced by HTX in October primarily centered around the AI sector, featuring projects such as POD, AXIS, DNA, and NMR. Notably, Axis Robotics (AXIS), which focuses on physical AI and robotics training data, was jointly launched as a primary listing by HTX, surging by up to 37% following its debut.

HTX Earn Offers APY Boost on 7 Products, USDT Loan Rates Maintain Strong Competitiveness

In October, user interest in HTX Earn continued to rise. SVIP Flexible subscriptions among users with large holdings remained exceptionally popular, with participating users increasing by 16.1% month-on-month and subscription volume surging by over 20% month-on-month.

On October 31, HTX Earn launched an APY Boost Promotion as part of the HTX Winter Campaign. The promotion offers APY boosts on 7-day fixed products featuring an APY of up to 10% for three mainstream coins (BTC, ETH, TRX) and four stablecoins (USDT, USDC, USDS, USDD). Each user can subscribe for up to 2 million USDT worth of each respective asset in the 7-day fixed product for that asset. By subscribing to all seven assets, a user can access a combined  boosted APY quota of up to approximately 14 million USDT, fully accommodating the asset allocation needs of users with large holdings. After the products mature, users can subscribe again, ensuring strong liquidity for their funds.

In terms of borrowing, HTX’s USDT loan interest rates maintained robust competitiveness across the industry. In October, the platform’s annualized USDT loan interest rate ranged from 4.75% to 5.3%, with discounted rates for large-volume borrowers as low as 3.84%, empowering users to unlock the capital potential of their holdings at lower costs. During the HTX Margin Autumn Craze, USDT loan scale grew by 18.6% month-on-month, and margin trading volume surged by over 128%. Currently, the HTX Margin Trading & Borrowing Bonanza Month is underway and will run through November 25, offering 7 tiers of rewards for USDT loans alongside up to a 50% fee rebate on trades during the Margin Trading Contest.

In the OTC sector, HTX has continued to expand payment channels for its OTC Desk, partnering with multiple payment providers to further optimize the user trading experience and reduce transaction costs.

$HTX Q3 Burn Performance Shines, TOKEN2049 Spotlights Brand Influence

On October 15, HTX DAO completed its $HTX token burn for Q3 2026. A total of approximately 9.39 trillion $HTX tokens were burned, valued at roughly $15.48 million, representing a quarter-over-quarter burn volume increase of approximately 25.6%. This brings the cumulative total of $HTX burned and pledged to 127.17 trillion tokens to date. Under HTX DAO’s established mechanism, HTX acts as an ecosystem partner, dedicating 50% of its quarterly revenues to $HTX buybacks and burns.

From October 6 to 8, global crypto attention converged on TOKEN2049 in Singapore. HTX Ventures, the global investment arm of HTX, made its presence felt at the Sands Expo and Convention Center in Singapore, where Unitree robots and Huobao (HTX mascot) IP parades, and multiple targeted lucky draws attracted large crowds of visitors . Meanwhile, HTX DAO hosted multiple sideline events during the summit. At HTX DAO Future Night, Justin Sun, Advisor to HTX and a core supporter of HTX DAO, delivered a video address sharing perspectives on crypto industry trends and the future development of the digital economy, highlighting the free flow of value within the digital world as a major trend worth watching over the coming decade. At the VIP private dinner, the HTX team engaged in deep dialogues with industry representatives, ecosystem contributors, and partners, exchanging viewpoints on industry evolution, market shifts, and product experiences to foster mutual understanding while optimizing services and expanding collaborations.

Standing by Users Through Every Market Cycle

Markets fluctuate. Facing market ups and downs, what the platform can do for users is deliver a better trading experience with each transaction, introduce valuable innovative products and practical rewards, and firmly safeguard user asset security. Compliance is the foundation of all these efforts. In October, HTX continued to deepen constructive communication with relevant regulatory authorities and work toward the proper resolution of relevant matters, while further strengthening its compliance measures. These efforts create more favorable conditions for focusing on user services and pursuing long-term development. Over the past 13 years, HTX has weathered market cycles one after another alongside users worldwide. This winter, HTX will continue to uphold a user-first philosophy, accompanying every user through the cold season and awaiting the arrival of the next cycle together.

KuCoin Earn is a one-stop wealth management service platform created by KuCoin. Users can use various financial products to increase the value of their holdings.

How is my PnL calculated?
Once you select “Sign up now” and successfully register for the event, we’ll track your trades on the designated tokens and trading pairs through the OKX DEX Aggregator during the event. Each competition category has its own leaderboard.

PnL leaderboard: ranked based on your total realized PnL

· Airdrop rewards

FAQ

Who’s eligible for the Flash Earn (Stake to Earn) campaign?

Users who have completed identity verification and meet the eligibility requirements of the selected campaign may participate. Flash Earn Stake to Earn currently supports master accounts only. Sub-accounts and institutional accounts are not supported.

Can I redeem my funds?

As Flash Earn (Stake to Earn) is a flexible product, you can redeem your funds anytime after subscription. You can redeem from either the campaign landing page or under Assets > Earn.
When the campaign ends, if you haven’t redeemed manually, we’ll automatically reinvest eligible crypto (such as USDT, OKB, and many others) into Simple Earn. Any unsupported crypto will be returned to your Funding account within 2 hours.

What rewards will I receive?

You’ll receive two types of rewards:
(1) an airdrop of a newly-listed token (principal-protected), and
(2) a base reward in your subscription crypto that’s generated with Simple Earn.
Learn more about

.

How are rewards calculated?

Rewards are calculated hourly.

Simple Earn rewards begin in the second hour after your funds are lent out. If not lent out, no rewards are generated.

Airdrop rewards for newly listed tokens also begin up to 2 hours after subscription.

If you redeem your funds within one hour after subscription, you won’t earn any rewards for that hour.

When are rewards distributed?

Rewards are distributed hourly. Rewards from a one-hour period will be distributed in the following hour after calculations are completed.

For example, rewards for the time period of 3:00 UTC to 4:00 UTC will be sometime between 4:00 and 5:00 UTC.

How do I claim my rewards?

You can claim your accumulated rewards at any time from the relevant Flash Earn Stake to Earn campaign page. Alternatively, go to Assets > Earn, select the applicable order, and click Claim. All accumulated claimable rewards can be claimed in one action.

If you do not claim your rewards before the campaign ends, the system will automatically distribute the remaining rewards to your Funding Account within four hours after the campaign closes.

VIP Exclusive | BXUSD US Treasury Wealth APY Boost
BingX
2026-11-13 08:20
To thank VIP users for their long-term support, BingX is launching an exclusive APY boost benefit for BXUSD US Treasury Wealth. In addition to the base APY of the BXUSD US Treasury product, VIP users can get an APY boost based on their VIP level. The higher the level, the higher the boost rate and the maximum eligible amount.
For details on the BXUSD US Treasury Wealth product, please refer to: https://bingx.com/support/articles/17740950186639
 

I. Benefit effective days

Phase 1: 2026-11-25 00:00 to 2026-12-25 00:00 (UTC+8)
This benefit is valid long-term for natural VIP users. The APY boost benefit and interest rates may be adjusted each phase. Refer to the official announcement for the current phase for the most accurate details.
 

II. Benefit details

Your VIP APY = Base APY + VIP APY boost
Notes:
  • Higher levels offer an APY boost and max boost that are no lower than those of the level below.
  • The base APY follows the yield currently in effect for the BXUSD US Treasury product.
  • If you subscribed before the VIP rate boost benefit launched, you don't need to manually redeem. The system will automatically calculate and pay your boost reward based on your actual daily VIP level after the upgrade.
*Special note: BXUSD currently offers a limited-time universal subsidy of 0.90%, which is included in the base APY of the BXUSD Wealth product. The base APY shown on the current page consists of two parts: the base U.S. Treasury yield plus the platform's limited-time universal subsidy.
Note that the platform's limited-time universal subsidy is a temporary policy open to all users. Once the subsidy ends, the product's base APY will return to the base U.S. Treasury yield.
Going forward, changes to the base APY will mainly come from two factors: the expiration of the limited-time universal subsidy, and changes in the U.S. Treasury yield itself. Refer to the real-time rate shown on the corresponding product page for the exact figure.

 

III. Interest-bearing principal

  • The APY boost is calculated only on the BXUSD principal you hold, up to your level's max boost. Any amount exceeding this limit earns interest at the base APY.
  • Interest is calculated based on your actual VIP level at the time of settlement. After a level change, the benefit of the new level applies.

IV. Settlement and distribution

  • After a successful subscription, interest starts accruing from the next 14:00 (UTC+8). Rewards are automatically distributed to the Spot Account under your main account at around 18:00 (UTC+8) on the day after interest accrual begins, and accumulate in BXUSD.
  • There are two types of rewards:
    • Daily reward: Calculated and distributed daily using the formula [Holdings × APY ÷ 365]
    • Boost reward: This benefit applies only to users at natural VIP levels. Newly subscribed shares will be included in the snapshot calculation on the day after subscription, and interest payments will start from the day after the calculation is completed.
  • Eligible holdings: Rewards are calculated based on the combined BXUSD balance in your Spot Account and USDⓢ-M Futures Account. The system takes multiple snapshots of your BXUSD holdings in the above accounts each day, and uses the lowest snapshot value of the day as your eligible holding amount. A minimum holding of 0.1 BXUSD is required to generate rewards. If you transfer BXUSD from your master account to a sub-account, rewards generated from the sub-account's holdings will also be consolidated and distributed to the master account's Spot Account. You can view daily details of your daily rewards in [BXUSD landing page - History] or [Spot Account - Transaction History - Wealth], including the interest-bearing amount, APY, rewards, payout time, and arrival status.
  • The VIP APY boost rewards are distributed to the Spot Account. The base APY follows the original US Treasury product rules and is not affected.
 

V. How to participate

Method One: Through the VIP page
  1. Open the app, go to the VIP personal page, check the Exclusive US Treasury Offer, and confirm your VIP APY.
  2. Tap "Subscribe" to go to the BXUSD US Treasury RWA page.
  3. After you complete the subscription, the system automatically applies your VIP APY boost.
Method Two: Direct subscription
Go directly to the US Treasury Wealth page to complete your subscription. The APY boost for natural VIP users takes effect automatically:
App: Home > Wealth > BXUSD > Subscribe to BXUSD *To subscribe to BXUSD in the app, first update the app to version 5.7.0 or later (expected to be released after 11-25). If you haven't updated yet, you can subscribe directly on the web instead.
Web: BingX homepage > Wealth in the top navigation bar > BXUSD > Subscribe to BXUSD: https://bingx.com/wealth/bxusd
 

VI. Rules and notes

  • This benefit is based on your natural VIP level. Trial pass users are not eligible for this benefit.
  • This benefit is recalculated daily based on user's latest VIP level.
  • The benefit's effective date and termination date are based on the UTC+8 natural day. Once the benefit is delisted, it no longer applies to new subscriptions.
  • US Treasury Wealth products are currently unavailable in certain countries and regions. Users whose KYC region is restricted will not see the entry for this benefit.

APY is a floating rate that may be adjusted based on market conditions. Historical yields do not represent future returns.
